top_signals.title: European Gas Prices Climb as Cold Snap Threatens Depleted Reserves
top_signals.summary: European benchmark natural gas prices rose on Tuesday for the fourth consecutive trading session as a cold snap this week is set to accelerate withdrawals from storage, where levels were at multi-year lows at the start of the heating season. The front-month price at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility (TTF), the benchmark for Europe’s gas trading, topped $98.77 (90.50 euros) per megawatt-hour (MWh) in the early morning in Amsterdam trade, rising by about 1% and extending the sharp gains from Monday.
